composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. creative_direction: Create a mint accordion sheet curled into a half-open shell. Use seven broad pleats with visible thickness, keeping the outer silhouette rounded and compact. The deep blue background stays empty, with no extra particles or objects. Use folded-material abstract rendering. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
